SEARCH
Package Services

Class PlayerService

java.lang.Object
Services.PlayerService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerService extends Object implements Serializable
The PlayerService class provides services related to players in the game. It includes operations such as adding or removing players, assigning colors, countries, and continents, calculating armies, checking for unexecuted orders or unassigned armies, and updating player information.

    • assignColors

      public void assignColors(GameState p_gameState)

    • assignCountries

      public boolean assignCountries(GameState p_gameState)
      Assigns countries to players in the game state. Each player is assigned a set number of countries based on the total number of countries available and the number of players. Additionally, assigns continents to players based on the countries they own.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The game state containing the map and the list of players.
      Returns:
      true if countries are successfully assigned, false otherwise.

      public void performContinentAssignment(List<Player> p_players, List<Continent> p_continents)

      p_players - The list of players to whom continents will be assigned.
      p_continents - The list of continents available for assignment.

    • calculateArmiesForPlayer

      public Integer calculateArmiesForPlayer(Player p_player)
      Calculates the total number of armies available for deployment for a player. The calculation includes base armies based on the number of countries owned by the player and additional armies based on the continents owned by the player.
      Parameters:
      p_player - The player for whom the armies are calculated.
      Returns:
      The total number of armies available for deployment for the player.

    • assignArmies

      public void assignArmies(GameState p_gameState)
      Assigns armies to each player based on the number of countries and continents they own. The number of armies assigned to each player is calculated using the calculateArmiesForPlayer method.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The current game state containing information about players, countries, and continents.
